Each pair shows the source patch on the left and its simulated reflection on the right. Values below are output sRGB.
Measured inputs include display primaries and standard colorimetric functions. Layer speeds, dye spectra, reaction rates, scattering and backing are design parameters.
Chemistry uses relative units and independent lateral grids. Bleach and fix are ideal endpoints. Reflection treats the coating as a homogeneous diffuse slab.
The chemistry studio runs these equations in a browser worker. Python provides the reference implementation and an optional compiled development kernel.
